name: What should I look for when hiring a general contractor for property maintenance services?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when hiring a general contractor for property maintenance services?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a general contractor for residential property maintenance, prioritize licensed and insured professionals. Look for contractors with a strong local reputation, positive customer reviews, and demonstrable experience in the specific services you require. Ensure they provide clear, written estimates, offer transparent communication, and are willing to discuss their process and timelines. Verifying their qualifications and checking references can help ensure you select a reliable and competent partner for your home's upkeep.
acceptedAnswer.description: When hiring a contractor, look for licensing, insurance, strong local reputation, clear estimates, and positive reviews to ensure reliability.
